features: Introduced a native Windows installer interface with installation-folder selection, optional desktop shortcuts, progress display, cancellation confirmation, and an option to launch Pi Desk after installation.
changed: The model-context dialog now defaults to the system prompt and supports viewing context while the session is running.

Simplified MCP management with automatic status loading, direct sign-in, reconnect and sign-out actions, connection retry, and newest-first notifications. Signing in keeps the model-context dialog open.
MCP sign-out now asks for confirmation before deleting shared credentials and offers server selection when needed.
Refined the Todo popover with a wider, centered layout, a persistent progress header, and clearer active-task and blocked-task indicators.
fixed: Hardened Windows desktop window controls by validating page origins, restricting operations to the current window, and withholding the window-control bridge from embedded frames.
